source: sim.demo_feed: recorded trust data with synthetic positions; no simulator was running

alt_text.clip.mp4: A person supervising simulated drones: uav2 is flagged as not trusted, the console recommends landing it, the person holds a button to approve, and the approval is recorded with their name. Captions say nothing moves until a person approves.
